prestockDefinition: A PreStock is tokenized economic exposure to a private company. It confers no ownership, voting, dividend, or information rights. Issuer pages describe holder-facing conversion windows when the company IPOs, is acquired, or otherwise changes state. Missed deadlines expire tokens worthless.

spacex.statement: SpaceX has gone public. Tokens must be swapped into $SPCXx or any other token before 11:59pm UTC on 12 March 2027 or they expire worthless.
spacex.settlement: TRADE via Jupiter Swap V2 /order + /execute, not a 1:1 rollover, not T-MINUS escrow

xai.statement: xAI was acquired by SpaceX. Each XAI token must be swapped into 0.7165 SPACEX before 11:59pm UTC on 12 September 2026 or expire worthless.
xai.tminus: EXPIRED — no signature, no transaction request

jupiterPath.chosen: Swap API V2 GET /swap/v2/order then user signTransaction then POST /swap/v2/execute
jupiterPath.why: Documented user-signed happy path with managed landing. /order with taker returns an assembled transaction. /execute lands it. Trigger V2 excludes transfer-fee mints. Ultra /ultra/v1/order+execute is the same signing model; T-MINUS already uses swap/v2 which is the documented Meta-Aggregator path.

whitespace: The PreStocks ecosystem has trading, routing, wallets, and mark data. It does not operationalize issuer events into a machine-readable holder action with chain + market + execution gates. That is T-MINUS.

architecture.name: PreStocks Asset Lifecycle & Action Engine
